# UX Checklist: Access, Sharing, And Downloads

**Purpose**: Validate UX, accessibility, localization, and clean-room requirements quality before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-06-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are list-row access states specified for owner, team, shared, and absent unauthorized meetings? [Completeness, UI Contract §Meeting List States]
- [x] CHK002 Are detail states specified for owner, team, shared, denied, unavailable, and deleted/lifecycle placeholders? [Completeness, UI Contract §Detail Access States]
- [x] CHK003 Are share modal/drawer controls specified: add user, active grants, revoke, copy login-required link, team visibility, and public links disabled? [Completeness, UI Contract §Share Modal Or Drawer]
- [x] CHK004 Are artifact download/export states specified for available, policy blocked, owner only, processing, missing, failed, deleted, and audit unavailable? [Coverage, UI Contract §Download And Export States]
- [x] CHK005 Are deletion/egress truth copy requirements present wherever download/export is offered? [Completeness, Spec FR-013, Egress Contract §Deletion Truth Copy]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the browser/server ownership boundary clear enough to avoid duplicating access/share/download policy inside desktop UI code? [Clarity, Spec FR-016, Plan Structure Decision]
- [x] CHK007 Is the desktop embedded behavior clear enough for compact routes without hiding native capture truth or adding recording controls? [Clarity, UI Contract §Desktop Embedded Behavior]
- [x] CHK008 Are Russian localization, no-overflow, keyboard focus, accessible names/tooltips, and non-color status cues documented for the new controls? [Clarity, UI Contract §Accessibility And Localization]
- [x] CHK009 Are clean-room constraints explicit enough to use Krisp as IA/state reference without copying copy, icons, assets, visual treatment, or private data? [Consistency, Spec FR-017, UI Contract §Clean-Room And Evidence Rules]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK010 Can sanitized desktop-width and mobile-width screenshots objectively prove share/access/download/export UI states? [Measurability, Spec SC-007]
- [x] CHK011 Are denied and revoked user experiences measurable without exposing private meeting content? [Measurability, Spec US1/US2]
- [x] CHK012 Are unavailable artifact states described as user-visible truth rather than hidden implementation errors? [Coverage, Spec US3/US4]
